personality_one_liner: A tactile, organic, and highly legible experience that uses tonal botanical greens and adaptive surfaces to make document scanning feel natural and effortless.

spacing.rule: Use tonal spacing and adaptive surfaces. Let color and whitespace participate in hierarchy. Do not use cramped padding.

do's: Floating action buttons over scrolling content
Bottom sheet drag handles and headers
Subtle blur on the header when scrolling History
dont's: No blur on camera capture screen (performance reasons)
No blur on the core OCR text input fields

screens.name: History (Home)
screens.purpose: A warm, organized landing screen showing past scanned notes with a prominent Floating Action Button to start a new scan.

states.empty: Illustration of a handwritten notebook and a friendly prompt to start scanning.
states.error: Failed to load history, retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'LipiScan' display text. Vertical ScrollView of previous OCR extractions (cards with thumbnail, timestamp, and snippet). FAB (pill-shaped or large circle) positioned bottom right with glassmorphism over the scrolling content.

screens.name: CameraCapture
screens.purpose: High-performance full-screen camera viewfinder for capturing handwritten notes.

states.error: Camera permission denied message with a button to open Settings.

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera view. Dark transparent scrim outside the scanning area to form a clear rectangular guide frame (corner brackets). Instructional text ('Position handwritten note within the frame') below the guide. Bottom controls: large primary capture button (brandPrimary), gallery/cancel button (surfaceInverse).

screens.name: QualityCheck
screens.purpose: Post-capture validation screen to ensure the image is usable for OCR.
screens.layout: Displays the captured image in the background. A bottom sheet automatically slides up displaying the quality check result. If poor quality (blur/dim/no-text): 'Retake' (primary), 'Proceed Anyway' (secondary). If good quality: 'Extract Text' (primary), 'Retake' (secondary).

screens.name: OcrReview
screens.purpose: Allows the user to review the extracted Bengali + English text against the original image and make corrections.

states.empty: No text detected in the image.

screens.layout: Split layout. Top 35% is the cropped image of the handwritten note (zoomable/pannable). Bottom 65% is a bottom sheet panel containing a large multiline TextInput (surfaceSecondary) for editing the extracted text. Text should be highly legible. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom: 'Append to Document'.

screens.name: DocumentAppend
screens.purpose: Select a target DOCX file and define where the extracted text should be inserted.
screens.layout: List of recent '.docx' files. 'Browse Device' button at the top. Once a file is selected, a segmented control appears (End of file, After heading, Custom). Sticky primary CTA at the bottom: 'Save Document'.

empty_history.alt: abstract botanical leaf shadow background for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Use tonal surfaces rather than heavy shadows. The app uses '2 Material You / Expressive LIGHT' personality with a botanical green palette (#386650 base).
Avoid generic Material Design indigo/blue. Stick to the provided botanical green and warm sand theme tokens.
For the camera layout, ensure a clear, dark scrim overlays the camera feed with a transparent central rectangle (and corner brackets) to guide the user.
QualityCheck and OcrReview screens MUST use a bottom sheet (e.g., @gorhom/bottom-sheet) so the user can see the captured image in the background while interacting with the controls or text.
Make the OCR text edit area highly legible (TextInput with multiline). Ensure the primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom.
In the Document Append screen, clearly distinguish the selected document state and show the append options (End, After heading) in a clean segmented control.
Include subtle haptics on all major interactions (capture button, retake, save, tab switches).
